title: Function of bounded variation on an interval
evidence:

For the catalogue right A-action y*a, use (MulOpposite.op a) • y := y*a, and take its opposite-valued inner product to be MulOpposite.op of the catalogue inner product B(x,y). The class law inner_op_smul_right:80 reads innerOpp x ((op a)•y)=(op a)*innerOpp x y, hence, because multiplication in the opposite algebra reverses order, exactly B(x,y*a)=B(x,y)*a. Thus positivity and separation, and CompleteSpace where required, are unchanged. A raw CStarModule A E would express left multiplication in its second-slot scalar law; the opposite-algebra instantiation is the exact right-A interpretation.
